description: This file contains unit tests for the Core::DoorBell class, testing its ring and wait functionalities within the WPEFramework project. It uses Google Test framework for assertions and includes test cases for setting and reversing the doorbell signals.

methods.name: simpleSet
methods.description: Test case that verifies the doorbell can be set and acknowledged correctly, simulating two rings and synchronization between threads.

methods.name: simpleSetReversed
methods.description: Test case that verifies the doorbell can be triggered before waiting, testing the reversed order of operations.
